newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Moran well in PNG flows oil at peak 8,064 bpd.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moran well in PNG flows oil at peak 8,064 bpd.

text.p: The Moran 1X Side Track No 4 well in Papua New Guinea flowed oil at a peak rate of 8,064 barrels per day (bpd) and gas at the rate of 19.83 million cubic feet per day during a deliverability test of the Toro Sandstone on Tuesday, Oil Search Ltd said on Wednesday.
The test was on a two-inch choke at a flowing well head pressure of 991 pounds per square inch, it said in a drilling report. The oil was of 47.2 degree API gravity.
The Toro Sandstone drill stem test main flow period was conducted on February 2 and 3 and flowed oil at an average rate of 2,007 bpd and gas at 5.274 million cubic feet per day.
Oil Search said the oil rate was constrained during this test to optimise conditions for obtaining reservoir information during the flow period and shut-in buildup.
After the flow buildup, the deliverability test was made.
No water was produced during both tests.

"The objectives of the Moran-1X S/T No. 4 well to evaluate the structural configuration of the Toro, Digimu and Iagifu Sandstones at the Moran-1X discovery, and to drill stem test the Toro and Digimu sandstones have now been achieved," it said.
The forward plan is now to complete the well as a multi-zone potential future producer, Oil Search said.
The well is located in permit PDL-2 in the central Papuan Highlands, 11 km north of the Agogo processing facilities which form the northern extension of the Kutubu development.

The PDL-2 licence holders participating in the well are: Oil Search 7.763 percent, Chevron Corp (operator) and The British Petroleum Co Plc 19.375 percent each, The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd 9.688 percent, Mobil Corp unit Ampolex Ltd 16.455 percent, Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd affiliate Japan Papua New Guinea Petroleum Co Ltd (JPP) 4.844 percent, Orogen Minerals (Ltd 15.750 percent and Petroleum Resources Kutubu Pty Ltd 6.750 percent.
